summary: Write z = ∑ c(x)v(x) and v(x) = ∑ r_x(y)v′(y); the coefficients ∑_x c(x)r_x(y) have support in A′, are integral away from n up to e, and have size ≤ B·|B′| ≤ C under p.

steps.claim: By h, z = ∑_x c(x)·v(x) with c admissible for (A, n, d, p, B); by hd, e = d·d′·k for a natural number k; by H, for each x ∈ A choose r_x admissible for (A′, n, d′, p, B′) with v(x) = ∑_y r_x(y)·v′(y).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨⟨c, hc, ⟨⟩⟩, ⟨⟩⟩ := h, hd; choose! r hr e using H

steps.claim: Take the coefficients ρ = ∑_{x ∈ supp c} c(x)·r_x. Then z = ∑_y ρ(y)·v′(y) by linearity; the support of ρ lies in A′ (each r_x is supported in A′ for x ∈ supp c ⊆ A); and e·ρ(y) = k·∑_x (d·c(x))·(d′·r_x(y)) is a sum of products of elements of integralAway(n), hence lies in integralAway(n). Only the size bound remains.
steps.lean:
use c.support.sum (⇑c • r), ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> intros <;> simp_all [↓← @linearCombination_apply α',
    sum, hc.1, Finset.mul_sum] <;> (try apply sum_mem) <;> try grind [IsAdmissibleCoeffs,
    Finset.sum_eq_zero, mul_mem, natCast_mem, mul_comm, mul_assoc]

steps.claim: Under p, for every automorphism σ of ℂ: ∑_y |σ(ρ(y))| ≤ ∑_x |σ(c(x))|·∑_y |σ(r_x(y))| ≤ ∑_x |σ(c(x))|·|B′| ≤ B·|B′| ≤ C, by the triangle inequality, the size bounds of r_x (x in the support of c, so in A) and of c, and hB.
steps.lean:
grw [← hB, ← hc.3 ⟨⟩, sum_mul, sum, ← le_abs_self, norm_sum_le, Finset.sum_comm, norm_mul_le]
  gcongr
  grw [← (hr _ (hc.1 _ ‹_›)).3 ⟨⟩, mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_filter_ne_zero, sum]; gcongr; aesop_cat
